'''Taan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. While she was young, her mother was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Thaereian military]], and Taan and her brother, [[Dyrla]], were subsequently raised by their father. Following the [[Liberation of Thaere|capture]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thaere Privo]] by the [[Cularin Militia]], Taan and Dyrla attended a Militia parade on the world [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
